reasons.plausibility: The short-range-order explanation for enhanced strength in reduced-component alloys aligns with known effects of local ordering on dislocation motion, though detailed experimental evidence for these alloys is still emerging.
reasons.testability: Measuring CSRO via diffraction methods and correlating it with mechanical properties under controlled compositions and processing provides a clear path to verify or refute the proposed mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: It directly connects a structural mechanism (CSRO) to mechanical performance, offering a practical framework for compositional and processing decisions in high-entropy alloy research.
